title: Return an owned reading
prompt: For nonnegative input, allocate an int with std::make_unique and return its unique owner. Reject negative input with std::invalid_argument. The caller may move the owner and read its value.

tests.label: Owner move
tests.hint: A unique owner can be moved to another variable.

hints: Moving a unique_ptr transfers the owner.
explanation: The unique_ptr owns the heap int and releases it at the end of its lifetime. No manual delete is required.
